digest.component_or_area: Jira DC verification oracle — external test harness
propositions: Atlassian ended new Jira Data Center license purchases; no official OpenAPI spec exists; the harness must use a real pinned Jira instance to validate DC adapter behavior against a non-Cloud deployment.

The harness builds from a vendored Dockerfile that pins the addono base by digest and includes two mandatory AMPS flags whose absence breaks every cold start; the image is not pulled but built locally.

The harness runs only on native amd64 runners; on emulated arm64 hosts Jira boot exceeds 10 minutes and the Cargo deploy watchdog kills the container, making verification impossible without a native architecture.

The harness downloads Jira 8.17.1 at runtime from maven.atlassian.com; egress to that repository is a hard dependency, the first start is dominated by a ~900-artifact fetch, and persistent Maven caching must be mounted to avoid repeated downloads.

PAT bearer authentication is exercised by creating a token programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and using it in an Authorization header, proving the DC auth mode works against a real 8.17.1 instance.

Teardown is index-independent; every created issue is verified to return 404 from its direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint, and residue from prior runs is detected by scanning /rest/api/2/project for leftover scratch projects keyed with the RBJ prefix.
